text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home from going out with K.S.Miracle—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today.
It was a nice breath of fresh air,
and I was really happy that you invited me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...It's still light out.
Would you like to take a short walk with me, if that's alright?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've been busy lately so I haven't been able to do it much, but...
I really enjoy walking without any particular destination in mind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, was that shop always there...?
Maybe it got a makeover?
choice_data_list: Maybe it's just the display that changed?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, you're right.
Just changing the posters and shop decorations a little
gives it a completely different atmosphere, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Every time the seasons or trends change,
my view feels brand new,
and I find it rather delightful.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Wow, so much merch I've never seen before.
This month's new arrivals corner... Pre-orders open for next month's releases..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
S-So many new things keep
coming out one after another, huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah. The bestseller rankings...
It seems the sales shift every time
there's a major race.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That sign over there says,
'Who are you cheering for?'"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It looks like
people are buying my plushies too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the people who support me,
I need to achieve even greater success.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Over there.
It used to be an empty lot.
There's a shop built there now. A general store, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...The pavement on that road over there
seems different than before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, that's true.
While I was busy, it seems a lot of changes
have taken place in the scenery I was so used to.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought this earlier as well,
but you can really feel the passage of time."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Some people feel lonely when things change like this. It really is sad when something that was once there disappears, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“I suppose it's not all bad,
either.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's sad when things disappear.
But watching what we have now change and evolve is, how should I put it—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's it. Not disappearing,
or being changed by someone else's will—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you are "evolving" by your own will,
I think that's... a truly wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?
We kinda got sidetracked from talking about the scenery, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Basically,
it means I want to change too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Not just surrendering yourself to time,
drifting along with the flow, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to choose my own destination of my own free will.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to evolve.
From here on out, too."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Yes.
I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you, Trainer,
I know we can keep moving forward... anywhere.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, yeah, something like that.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Once you get used to the scenery as it is now,
you sometimes forget what it used to look like, though."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because there was a past,
there is the present leading to the future.
...That's how I feel about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle is gazing
far off into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not the scenery right before my eyes,
but a far distant, brilliantly shining future—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
No matter how much the scenery changes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
These casual moments right here beside us... I don't want them to change.
...I also hold such contradictory feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle's eyes, tinged with a faint trace of anxiety,
meet mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A response that sounded almost like wishful thinking.
Even at those words,
K.S. Miracle gave a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...I'm sure everything will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without any certainty,
I can only pray that it is so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a vague exchange,
I brushed aside the rising anxiety.
